intended_object: A helper constructor. It turns an oriented grid rectangle whose right side is the column line `finRotate n a`, and whose row span contains `s`, into a `GridPentagonBetween a s u v` structure (inferred from the docstring and the body).
explanation: `ofRightEq` is only a smart constructor. It takes a `GridRectangleBetween u v` and the two side conditions, and fills in the fields of `GridPentagonBetween` (`toGridRectangleBetween`, `right_eq`, `turn_mem`), exactly as the docstring says. It defines no new mathematical concept; it is library glue for building the combinatorial pentagon shape out of a rectangle. It has no counterpart in Mathlib, and asking whether it is faithful or general enough does not really apply.
